name: meeting-recap
description: Turns a meeting transcript into a short, skimmable recap: decisions, action items (owner + due date), topics, and open questions. Takes pasted text, a file, or a VTT/SRT/Otter/Zoom/Teams export; with a Microsoft 365 connector it finds the meeting on your calendar and pulls its Teams transcript, chat, files, and email. Collects shared links and images into lookup tables. Never fabricates names or deadlines, and tags anything sourced outside the transcript.
